## Problem

While verifying pm-cli's installed pm-changelog package, the latest npm package (`2026.5.24-8`) can generate all closed pm items, but clickable pm item references cannot be configured through the pm extension command.

The package CLI supports `--item-url-base`, and the generator supports `itemUrlBase`, but `pm changelog generate` rejects `--item-url-base` because `src/extension.ts` does not declare or pass the option. `--include-links` only appends existing `item.url` values, which pm-cli tracker items do not currently provide.

## Reproduction

In pm-cli with pm-changelog installed:

```bash
pm changelog generate --item-url-base https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/main/.agents/pm --stdout --title "pm Tracker Changelog" --group-by release --status closed
```

Observed: pm rejects `--itemUrlBase` / `--item-url-base` as an unknown extension command option.

## Expected

`pm changelog generate` should expose the same item URL base support as the package CLI and produce clickable item IDs like `[pm-abc](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/main/.agents/pm/tasks/pm-abc.toon)`.

## Notes

Do not work around this in pm-cli. The fix belongs in pm-changelog so downstream repos can use the package default flow for CI/CD changelog generation.
